Hello! Thank you so much for the appeal. Your words are very kind and I think your art style looks awesome! I would love to see you draw Admyra in your style.

She is a military android with a human soul embedded in her. Her height is 183cm. Externally, she can be cold, serious, and autonomous with her personality, but internally with her human soul she is kind, caring, and somewhat childlike. However, she also has an issue with bloodlust, in which she craves for murder.

Her abilities include mastery of two beam swords, manipulation and manifestation of her own shadow, and controlling small blades.

You can draw her however you feel, but I would love to suggest illustrating her in her bloodlust state, as indicated by the red-eyes face in the reference sheet. Please include her two beam swords, and if you would like, include her shadow manifesting as a demonic being behind her. Everything else (pose, background, etc.) is up to you!

Please be sure to pay attention to the symbols in her eyes and she must be wearing her hat. You can reduce some of the details in her outfit down a bit if you need to.

Thank you so much again!! 💜💜💜

残酷な優しさの雰囲気があるものは何でも楽しめる。宗教的なモチーフや設定も歓迎します。

"青髪・筧"
-身長は161cmくらいで、左目の目尻にほくろがあり、髪はややカールしている！
